Header text verbatim: "söndag". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "Sunday".
Scene: Weekly calendar has exact initials M T O T F L S in order with final S highlighted, adult relaxing on sofa, no dates.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "söndag = Sunday; the day after Saturday.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Vi vilar på söndag.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
